title: SignBridge dynamic-phrase recording metadata (DRAFT, research)
description: One record per original recording. Describes the recording, its signer (pseudonymous), capture settings, consent and licence status, annotations and review. No record may claim verified ISL meaning. Stage 3 defines the schema only; no real participant recordings are stored or validated by this file.

dataset_version.description: Separate from isl_phrases_v2_stage0 and the existing image dataset.

phrase_label.description: Must equal the catalogue label for phrase_id. Labels are unverified until reviewed.

signer_id.description: Pseudonymous. Never a name, initials or contact detail.

session_id.description: Recording session. Several signers may share a session.

original_fps.description: Frame rate of the original capture. Required for new recordings.

fps_status.description: How the frame rate was obtained. 'unknown' is not allowed for new recordings.

source_file.description: Path of the original video, relative to the recordings root. Never an extracted still.

consent_status.description: Only 'granted' allows collection or use with a real person.

dispute_note.description: Empty when the gesture is not disputed.

reviewer_id.description: 'none' while pending. A human reviewer is required before 'accepted'.

constraints: end_seconds must be greater than start_seconds, and end_seconds must not exceed duration_seconds
annotations must be ordered and must not overlap
a record with consent_status other than 'granted' may not be used with real participant data
review_status 'accepted' requires a reviewer_id other than 'none'
original_fps must be positive; 'unknown' frame rate is rejected for new recordings
